title: Influx
description: This is a item duplication mod for Minecraft.
body:
INFLUX

Influx Is a Minecraft Mod About It Duplication. this mod has new tools, armor, ores, food, and advancements for you to explore!




Features


There are new Tools better then netherite and a new armor set with abilites that fit with mining underwater. 

There are items that let you obtain anyblock such as bedrock, end portal frame, and more. You can duplicate blocks with the block absorber and you can duplicate blocks with nbt with the absolute block absorber. you can have a chest full of diamonds and duplicate it or maybe netherite or maybe modded blocks and items.

Permissions

You can use this mod in any modpack as long as credit is given.

Bugs


If you find a bug you can report it at

https://discord.gg/rj4EU2q5P4q5P4



This mod expands not just the vannila experiance but the modded one also.
